Who we are

Ganes Metplast Private Limited was established in 2011 and has grown into a reputed name across automotive and FMCG manufacturing — built on two business units that work as one.

We leverage the combined advantages of China and India. Representing Jing Mei Automotive (Hong Kong) in India, we develop plastic-part tooling and electroplated components to OEM specification — outside and inside door handles, levers and trims. Alongside it, a dedicated injection-moulding division in Chennai has served high-precision engineering and FMCG products since 2015, with precision tools and gauges developed by our counterpart in Shenzhen and a metallised finishing system available on demand from our counterpart in Japan. A packing-and-forwarding division, Ganes Movers & Packers, has supported the group since 2013, including pallet manufacture for repacking operations.
